FAST

Nov 14 : Former Australia opener David Warner on Saturday accused Cricket Australia of orchestrating a cover-up in its Sandpapergate investigation, alleging the governing body ignored key witnesses while seeking to pin blame on three players.
Former Australia batter Usman Khawaja, whose autobiography was published on Tuesday, said last weekend that all the players in the team at Newlands knew about the plot, triggering calls for a new investigation into the incident.
Warner questioned whether fast bowlers Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood, as well as spinner Nathan Lyon, had been formally interviewed as part of CA's inquiry, which resulted in lengthy bans for Warner, then-captain Steve Smith and Cameron Bancroft.
"As far as I am aware, CA did not interview Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc or Nathan Lyon in their 2018 investigation," Warner said on Instagram.

"If that's correct then how can CA push the idea that the bowlers didn't know?"
The 40-year-old, who earlier this week accused CA of conducting a "rushed" and "botched" probe that found the three punished players solely responsible for the plot, said the governing body had decided from the outset who would take responsibility for the scandal.
"It looks like they had decided who they wanted to blame from the very beginning, ran a shoddy investigation to serve the purpose and now they want to maintain the false narrative that the bowlers had no idea," Warner added. "That stinks of a cover-up."
The four bowlers who played in the Cape Town test against South Africa in 2018 - Starc, Hazlewood, Pat Cummins and Lyon - issued a joint statement in 2021 denying any knowledge of the ball-tampering plan.
Starc again denied any prior knowledge of the incident on Tuesday, while Australia captain Cummins dismissed suggestions of his involvement, describing the allegations as "utter nonsense" on Friday.
CA chief executive Todd Greenberg ruled out reopening the investigation into the Sandpapergate scandal on Tuesday.
Khawaja, meanwhile, told the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's "7:30" programme earlier this week that he hoped other teammates would speak honestly about the 2018 saga but he was not forcing anyone to do anything, nor calling on CA to re-investigate.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米中が初の貿易委員会会合、関税引き下げや農産物協議＝中国商務省
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［北京　１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［北京　１４日　ロイター］ - 中国商務省は１４日、米国と中国が１３日に貿易委員会の初会合を開き、関税引き下げや農産物貿易などを協議したと発表した。

「双方は、関税や『３００億ドル対３００億ドル』の相互関税引き下げ措置、農産物貿易のほか、互いに関心のある問題を含め、これまでの米中経済・貿易協議の成果の履行について、率直で踏み込んだ建設的な意見交換を行った」とした。

合意に達したかどうかには触れなかった。米中が今後も同委員会を活用して貿易上の懸念に対処し、協力を広げ、未解決の問題を減らしていくと述べた。

９月のワシントンでの米中首脳会談後、両国は総額６００億ドル規模の相互関税引き下げパッケージを提案した。パッケージには、中国が２０２４年に輸入した米国産農産物約１７０億ドル相当が含まれるが、計画はまだ最終決定されていない。

ロイターが今月行った税関データの分析によると、２０２６年の中国による大豆以外の米国産農産物の購入は、７年ぶりの低水準になる見通しだ。中国は２８年まで年間１７０億ドル分を購入することで合意しているが、この合意を巡る不透明感が根強く残っていることが浮き彫りになった。

中国政府は米国政府に対し、米国産農産物の購入拡大の前提条件だとして、６００億ドル規模の関税引き下げ合意を履行するよう繰り返し求めている。

LOS ANGELES, Nov 14 : And the award goes to ... AI music.
The first AI Music Awards ceremony in the US on Friday celebrated the people who created songs at least partly with AI, a field that has sparked criticism and lawsuits while also gaining millions of streams and landing on music charts.
At Friday’s event in downtown Los Angeles, human presenters and winners argued that artificial intelligence-created music should be viewed as part of a new genre that requires real-life artistry as well as hours of prompting to get the right sound.
"In a world where everybody calls AI fake, the human behind it is real," said music producer Drake Murphy as he presented the award for best AI hip-hop song.

The night's top awards of AI artist, song and album of the year went to Xania Monet, an AI-generated avatar known for "How Was I Supposed to Know?" Billboard said the R&B song was the first by an AI-based act to earn a spot on one of its radio charts.
Monet was created by Telisha "Nikki" Jones, who said she wrote all of the lyrics and then set them to music with the help of AI.
"I just feel like AI music is a new thing that people just have to get used to," Jones said on the red carpet before the ceremony. "I don't see it going anywhere anytime soon."
AI artists who are members of the Sonic Intelligence Academy, a company that created AI music charts and tools to identify songs made with AI, chose the winners.
ARTISTS TOUT AI AS A CREATIVE TOOL DESPITE BACKLASH
While the presence of AI in music-making can be traced back to the 1950s, groundbreaking advances in generative AI, with robots now making music as digital pop stars, have divided opinions in the industry.
Record labels have sued AI companies including Anthropic and OpenAI, arguing that they are illegally using copyrighted works to train their models. The Elvis Presley estate also filed a lawsuit. 
The companies have said they are protected by the "fair use" doctrine in US copyright law that allows unlicensed use in some cases.
Musicians worry that AI-generated music blocks human artists from gaining traction and takes work from producers, singers, engineers and songwriters.
Many of Friday’s nominees said they had stories to tell but did not have all of the skills needed to put them to music. They said AI was a tool that helped bring the music to life and they hoped the awards would show people there are humans behind AI music.
“A lot of things we do behind the scenes is hard work, contrary to popular belief," said nominee J. Frequency. “Art is art, and I think this is just another expression of that.”  

Source: Reuters

items.title: Mafalda llega a Netflix en 2027: la llamada de cinco minutos de Campanella que dio origen a la serie
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: La serie animada es dirigida por el cineasta argentino ganador del Óscar Juan José Campanella y se estrenará en 2027.
items.body: “Paren el mundo, que me quiero bajar...”. Mafalda, la irreverente niña de las historietas cómicas creadas por Quino, saltará al mundo del streaming con su propia serie animada en Netflix en 2027. Dirigida por el cineasta argentino ganador del Óscar Juan José Campanella, la emisión marcará un nuevo episodio en los más de 60 años del personaje. Pero ¿cómo pasó Mafalda, un personaje que nació en el papel, a tener su propia producción de Netflix? La respuesta, según Ramos, comenzó con una llamada de apenas unos minutos. “Juan me llamó un día y me preguntó: ‘¿Tienes cinco minutos hoy?’. Le respondí: ‘Para ti, siempre’. Es un amigo personal”, contó Ramos durante el Bloomberg Línea Summit 2026. “Me dijo que era algo urgente”, añadió. Ambos se reunieron por Zoom, donde Campanella le reveló la noticia: “He conseguido los derechos de la familia de Quino para hacer una serie de animación, pero tenemos que decidir inmediatamente si queremos hacerla o no”. El ejecutivo no dudó y le dijo que si la familia del historietista estaba dispuesta a trabajar con él, no tenía mayor objeción. “No sé si lo hubiésemos hecho con otra persona, pero con Juan, que haga lo que quiera”, señaló Ramos. Campanella, que ganó el Óscar por “El Secreto de de sus Ojos” es además guionista y productor de la serie a través de Mundoloco CGI, el estudio argentino de animación cofundado junto con Gastón Gorali. No es la primera vez que Mafalda salta al mundo animado, pues en 1981 se estrenó “Mafalda, la película”, dirigida por Carlos D. Márquez. Las historietas han acumulado éxito en América Latina y España y en 2025 se lanzó una edición en inglés de un tomo compilatorio. Hasta ahora, Netflix solo ha adelantado una imagen donde se ve al personaje sosteniendo un teléfono. Ramos reveló que el primer episodio ya está terminado y que otros tres aún están en desarrollo. “He visto el primer capítulo, es espectacular”, apuntó. “La gente que vio el primer capítulo está profundamente emocionada”. La nueva serie es una de las muchas produccione s que la compañía tiene prevista para 2027, un año en que busca consolidar su presencia en la región con emisiones como el documental del boxeador mexicano Saúl “El Canelo” Álvarez, y una serie biográfica de la exprimera dama de México Angélica Rivera.

items.title: Tanker hits cruise ship in New Orleans, 32 hospitalised, none critical
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The cruise ship, which still had about 129 passengers and an unspecified number of crew members aboard, began to sink before tipping over, sending people into the Mississippi River ...
items.body: By Cameron Fozi All passengers and crew members aboard a river cruise ship that capsized after a tanker collision in New Orleans on Friday were accounted for, with 32 people hospitalized but none critically injured, according to Mayor Helena Moreno. The Atlantic Asphalt tanker “lost control” and struck the American Heritage, operated by American Cruise Lines, around 12:30 p.m. at the Port of New Orleans, Moreno said at a news briefing. The cruise ship, which still had about 129 passengers and an unspecified number of crew members aboard, began to sink before tipping over, sending people into the Mississippi River. Harbor police were the first to respond, entering the water to pull people to safety as firefighters extended ladders from the dock. Volunteer crews in their own vessels also joined the rescue effort, Moreno said. “At this moment, the information that we have, we have zero people unaccounted for,” Moreno said. “Which truly is a miracle on the Mississippi.” Video of the incident aired by local television station WDSU, an NBC affiliate, showed a larger tanker approaching the docked cruise ship before the two vessels collided at what appeared to be a relatively slow speed. Later footage showed the American Heritage partly submerged in the river. The American Cruise Lines website describes the American Heritage as a classic paddlewheeler river boat with capacity for as many as 180 passengers, which was last renovated in 2022. “American Cruise Lines can confirm that our riverboat, American Heritage, was involved in a collision while it was docked in New Orleans,” the company said in a statement. “We are in close coordination with the US Coast Guard and local authorities. Guests and crew were evacuated, and we are deeply concerned for everyone involved.” Earlier on Friday, Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry said he was heading to New Orleans. “We are aware of the incident on the Mississippi and we are in close contact with local officials and law enforcement,” Landry said in a post on X. “I am headed to New Orleans now.”

Nov 14 : Binance said on Saturday that it aims to reopen withdrawals for all remaining networks and assets by the end of next week, as operations normalise for the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange after a security breach linked to North Korea saw $6.3 billion stolen from the platform last month.
"This week, we reopened withdrawals for 87 networks. We will aim to reopen withdrawals for all remaining networks and assets by the end of next week," the company said in an X post.
Binance resumed withdrawals in phases earlier this month, after covering 95 per cent of the $6.3 billion in tokens stolen from its platform in what experts describe as the largest cryptocurrency theft ever.

BEIJING: China and the United States discussed tariff cuts, agricultural trade and other issues at their first trade council meeting on Friday (Nov 13), China's Commerce Ministry said on Saturday, days ahead of an expected leaders' meeting in Shenzhen next week.
"The two sides held candid, in-depth and constructive exchanges on implementing the outcomes of previous China-US economic and trade talks, including tariffs, a reciprocal 'US$30 billion-for-US$30 billion' tariff-cut arrangement, agricultural trade and other issues of mutual concern," the ministry said.
It did not say whether any agreements were reached. Both sides will continue using the council to address trade concerns, expand cooperation and reduce outstanding issues, the ministry added.
Following a September summit between Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Washington, the two sides proposed a US$60 billion package of reciprocal tariff cuts, including roughly US$17 billion worth of US farm goods that China imported in 2024, but the plan has yet to be finalised.
Chinese purchases of US farm goods other than soybeans are on track to hit a seven-year low this year, despite an agreement to buy US$17 billion annually through 2028, a Reuters analysis of customs data showed earlier this month, underscoring persistent uncertainty over the deal.
Beijing has repeatedly urged Washington to implement the US$60 billion tariff-reduction deal, calling it a prerequisite for increasing purchases of US farm goods.
The White House said Trump will meet Xi on Thursday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen.

items.title: マイクロソフトの障害全面復旧、約1日がかり　1社依存のリスク鮮明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１４日　ロイター］ - 米マイクロソフトは１４日、「チームズ」や「アウトルック」などの業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」が全面的に復旧したと発表した。世界の企業や政府機関の業務に多大な影響を及ぼした大規模な障害は発生から２４時間余りでようやく解消した。

同社はＸへの投稿で「今回の事案の根本的な問題への対処を完了し、影響が残っていた顧客と地域のサービスを復旧させた」と明らかにした。「顧客やパートナーに与えた混乱について深くおわびする」と述べた。

障害検知サイト「ダウンディテクター」を運営するウークラによると、障害の報告は１２日１７２５ＧＭＴ（日本時間１３日午前２時２５分）ごろから増え始めた。

ダウンディテクターに寄せられた報告は世界全体で７４０万件を超えた。ピーク時には毎分２万件近くと、通常の１５００倍以上に達した。

今回の障害はマイクロソフト史上、最も長いものの一つ。「３６５」は昨年１０月と今年１月にも障害を起こしており、今年２度目となる。

今回の障害で企業や政府機関などが一握りの巨大ＩＴ企業に依存していることのリスクが鮮明になった。

取引プラットフォーム、イートロのマーケットアナリスト、ジョシュ・ギルバート氏は「より大きな懸念は、マイクロソフト３６５の障害が今年これが初めてではないことだ」とした上で「信頼性の問題が繰り返されているように見えれば、どのＩＴ部門も、事業をこれ以上一つのプロバイダーに委ねる前に考え直すだろう」と述べた。

モーニングスターＤＢＲＳの欧州金融機関担当バイスプレジデント、マリオ・デ・チッコ氏は、障害による業務の混乱や金銭的損失で保険金請求が相次ぐ可能性はあると指摘した。ただ、保険会社が受ける打撃は限られるとの予想する。

デ・チッコ氏の試算によると、今回の障害による世界の保険損害額は３億─５億ドル。２４年にクラウドストライクの障害で起きた損失（４億─１５億ドル）を大きく下回るという。

Modi's office summons telecom secretary over use of fake court orders, officials say

FAST

NEW DELHI, Nov 14 : Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's office summoned the telecommunications secretary on Saturday to explain how officials ordered the takedown of more than 100 websites based on fake court orders, two government officials said.
The intervention from Modi's office signals intensifying scrutiny after Reuters reported on Wednesday that telecom officials directed internet providers to block 129 illegal betting websites based on fake High Court orders which were emailed to officials by people posing as lawyers.
While online betting is illegal in India, the case has raised concerns that a lack of safeguards in India's content-takedown system could allow falsified court documents to be used to block legitimate websites.
The findings have triggered a criminal investigation by state police into potential forgery and cheating by unidentified people.

Modi's office summoned Telecom Secretary Amit Agrawal to appear and explain the lapse, cutting short Agrawal's trip to another state, said the two government officials with knowledge of the matter.
Agrawal is the most senior bureaucrat in the telecommunications ministry, which oversees everyone from big telecom operators to internet providers.
"The action taken by the Department of Telecommunications against betting accounts was carried out through the relevant field officers," one of the officials said.
Agrawal, his ministry and Modi's office did not respond to requests for comment.
Court precedents generated using AI have caused concerns among judges the world over. India's Supreme Court in July set aside a tribunal's orders that relied on non-existent judgments, and a US judge recently disqualified lawyers over use of fabricated legal citations.
On Friday, Reuters reported that the telecoms ministry had initiated an internal investigation into the alleged fraud, while police have sought ministry records as part of a criminal investigation.
The two state court orders flagged as fake by Reuters, based on comments from police and the court registry, contained fabricated court logos and seals, as well as a fake QR code.
They were available publicly on the Department of Telecommunications' website for months, along with correspondence that showed government officials ordering internet providers to remove the websites.
On Saturday, one of the fake court orders was still accessible on the government's website, while one had been removed.
Amid growing concerns over fake orders, India's Supreme Court justices last year said such fabrication "bearing forged signatures of Judges strikes at the very foundation of public trust" and "such grave criminal acts cannot be treated as ordinary or routine offences".

Source: Reuters

TOKYO, Nov 13 : Tesla said on Friday it was inviting select customers to buy the Cybercab for personal use, marking a push towards delivering fully designed autonomous vehicles to customers.
• Tesla posted the announcement on X with an image of the golden butterfly door two-seater, priced at $29,990 with an “Autonomy Subscription” of $299 a month.
• Chief Executive Elon Musk said in a post on X that the offering would be available nationwide as Tesla receives regulatory approval
• "The monthly fee is too high," Musk said, adding that it should match the cost of Tesla Full Self Driving and connectivity for other models, which is about $115 per month

• The EV maker aims to start selling its Cybercab robotaxis to the public by the end of this year, Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of vehicle engineering, said last month
• The Cybercab will work unsupervised in all the same geo locations as the robotaxi, Tesla’s head of artificial intelligence, Ashok Elluswamy, said in a separate X post
• Tesla launched its unsupervised robotaxi service in Austin, Texas, in June 2025, expanded the offering to Dallas and Houston in April 2026 and rolled it out in Miami in July 2026

items.title: Microsoft restores service to Outlook and Teams after global outage
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The outage crippled online communications for businesses and governments worldwide for over 24 hours.
items.body:

World

Microsoft restores service to Outlook and Teams after global outage

The outage crippled online communications for businesses and governments worldwide for over 24 hours.

Microsoft, Teams, Outlook and Copilot logos are seen through broken glass in this illustration taken on Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Dado Ruvic)

14 Nov 2026 03:56PM

FAST

Microsoft said on Saturday (Nov 14) that services had fully recovered across Teams, Outlook and its other products, ending a global outage that crippled online communications for businesses and governments for over 24 hours.
"We have completed our efforts to address the underlying issue of the incident and restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions," the company posted on X.
Microsoft had said server issues were behind the incident that also affected its Copilot AI assistant, and that it was not aware of any malicious activity, ruling out AI as the cause.
Outlook and Teams are two of the most widely used workplace applications with hundreds of millions of users. The outage prevented people from performing essential functions such as sending emails, managing calendars and hosting virtual meetings.

It affected government agencies from Singapore , Australia and Japan to the United States, caused delays at trading firms, hindered some companies from publishing earnings and prompted airlines to warn customers of communication lags, according to public statements.
Organisations that host Microsoft services on their own servers, rather than in the cloud, were somewhat spared.

Related:

'Microsoft-sponsored holiday': Singapore workers scramble to cope with global outage

Singapore government’s Outlook services fully restored after global Microsoft outage

ANOTHER OUTAGE FOR MICROSOFT The outage, reports of which started climbing around 1725 GMT on Thursday, according to Ookla, is one of the longest in Microsoft's history and the second disruption to its services this year.
Microsoft said the outage specifically hit features tied to Exchange Online - its cloud-based email and scheduling hub - leaving unconnected applications operational.
The incident deepens questions about the global reliance on a handful of Big Tech companies that supply both the essential software and the cloud infrastructure that underpins it.
It also highlighted the dependence on Microsoft's workplace software, with outage reports spiking as employees began their workdays across Asia and Europe, according to Downdetector's parent company, Ookla.
Downdetector logged more than 7.4 million reports worldwide, peaking at nearly 20,000 a minute, more than 1,500 times normal levels.
"It shows how much of the working day now runs through one provider's email and collaboration tools," said Luke Kehoe, lead industry analyst at Ookla.
Microsoft shares closed flat at US$523.88 on Friday. The stock has gained roughly 8 per cent so far this year.
Disruptions and financial losses from the outage could result in numerous insurance claims, but the overall hit to insurers is expected to be limited, said Mario De Cicco, vice-president of European financial institutions at Morningstar DBRS.
De Cicco estimated global insured losses from the incident at between US$300 million and US$500 million, well below the US$400 million to US$1.5 billion financial toll from the 2024 CrowdStrike outage that crashed more than 8 million Windows-based computers and caused widespread disruptions.

A Microsoft Outlook app icon is seen in this illustration taken on Nov 13, 2026. (Image: Reuters/Dado Ruvic)

Microsoft also faced an outage with its 365 services in January this year and in October last year. Last month, it reported an outage of its Azure cloud platform that impacted its suite of productivity software and a range of industries worldwide.
"The bigger worry is that this is not the first Microsoft 365 outage this year," said Josh Gilbert, a market analyst at trading platform eToro.
"If reliability starts to look like a recurring problem, it hands every IT department a reason to think twice before putting even more of their business in one provider's hands."
Still, some analysts have questioned whether such incidents can push customers on to rivals due to the steep switching costs of replacing tools embedded so deeply in daily operations.
TRADES HAD TO BE CONFIRMED BY FAX A spokesperson for the UK government said it was working with Microsoft to find a solution for the outage that hit organisations such as the NHS and London's Metropolitan Police.
Lack of access to emails and other services was impacting the Metropolitan Police's ability to report some crimes online, though its ability to respond to calls was not affected.
The NHS said its local services were turning to alternate measures such as using IT systems or paper records.

Related:

Microsoft 'deeply sorry' as outage triggers global chaos

Faxes, phones and Bluetooth: Microsoft outage forces businesses to find fixes

For businesses, the fallout was widespread.
European exchange operator Euronext reported email disruptions, British insurer Aviva activated backups for its earnings calls and Danish shipping giant Maersk warned customers of delayed updates.
American AI giants OpenAI and Anthropic also faced issues with Microsoft connectors that were later resolved, while Indian airlines IndiGo, Akasa Air and Air India said their email support services were impacted.
The outage also disrupted fund management at Taiwanese securities firms, life insurers, and investment trust companies. One of the companies went as far as cancelling a bond repurchase transaction, a source familiar with the situation told Reuters.
Another Taiwanese financial company resorted to using fax to confirm trades, a second source said.
In the US, electric truck maker Workhorse Group rescheduled its results on Thursday to Nov 16, while Switzerland's Richemont briefly delayed its first-half results announcement on Friday.
In Australia, where the spy agency and federal police were among organisations caught in the outage, Cyber Security Minister Tony Burke said Microsoft does not suspect a cyberattack.
"The impact that they are dealing with ... is very much on email systems," the minister added.

Source: Reuters/ws

FAST

Nov 14 : India batter Vaibhav Sooryavanshi became the youngest captain in men's Twenty20 history at 15 years and 232 days after leading Bihar in India's domestic T20 competition, the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, on Saturday.
• The teenager surpassed Croatia's Zach Vukusic, who previously held the record after captaining his national side at 17 years and 311 days.
• Sooryavanshi became India's youngest men's international in July when he made his T20 debut against England in Manchester, eclipsing Sachin Tendulkar's long-standing mark.
• He became India's 122nd men's T20 international at the age of 15 years and 99 days.

• The left-hander has played 10 T20Is, scoring 295 runs, including two half-centuries.
• Widely regarded as one of India's brightest prospects, Sooryavanshi earned his first senior call-up after a meteoric rise that began with a blistering 35-ball century in the Indian Premier League (IPL) last year.
• He further underlined his credentials in this year's IPL, finishing as the tournament's leading run-scorer, striking at more than 237 and setting a competition record with 72 sixes.

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝八村7得点11リバウンド、クリッパーズが接戦制す　ＮＢＡカップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は１３日、シーズン中のトーナメント戦であるＮＢＡカップを各地で行い、八村塁が所属する西カンファレンスＢ組のクリッパーズはサンダーとの接戦を１１３─１１２で制した。

八村は３１分４３秒の出場で７得点、１１リバウンド、３アシスト、１スチールとゴール下で存在感を示した。ブルック・ロペスがチーム最多の２６得点を記録。サンダーはシェイ・ギルジャス・アレクサンダーが４０得点をマークした。

Ｃ組のスパーズは、ウォリアーズに１２３─８５で快勝。ステフォン・キャッスルが両チーム最多の３２得点に、５リバウンド、６アシストをマークし、１１連勝に貢献した。

Ａ組のロケッツはジャズを１２５─１１８で下した。アルペレン・シェングンが４３得点、１２リバウンド、５アシストと躍動。ジャズは１１連敗となった。

東カンファレンスでは、Ｃ組のブルズがホークスに１２５─１１７で競り勝った。ノーマン・パウエルが両チーム最多の３３得点を記録したチームは、連敗を８でストップさせた。

Ａ組のマジックはバックスに１０７─９９で勝利した。フランツ・ワグナーが３５得点、９リバウンド、１２アシストとトリプルダブル級の活躍。バックスは９連敗となった。

Ｂ組のペーサーズはニックスに１０６─１０４で競り勝った。同組のヒートはキャバリアーズを１３３─１２１で下した。

EVERETT, WASHINGTON, Nov 14 : American Ilia Malinin shrugged off a minor error to lead the men's short program at Skate America in Everett, Washington, on Friday in his first competition since winning a third world title in March.
The 21-year-old scored 96.74 points to open a 5.45-point advantage over Japan's Sota Yamamoto, while Mexico's Donovan Carrillo sat third with 86.49 points heading into Saturday's free skate.
Malinin landed a quadruple flip and a triple Axel but made a mistake on his quadruple Lutz, putting a hand down on the ice and managing only a double toe-loop combination.
The error proved costly only on paper as the American's superior technical score kept him comfortably clear of the field.

"I think coming into the first competition, my goal was just to feel out the program, how it feels on the ice in front of the crowd," Malinin said.
"I definitely felt a lot of support behind that short program. I feel like as the season goes on, this short program is going to be really easy to skate."
The three-time world champion began his campaign directly on the Grand Prix circuit after opting against competing at a lower-level event earlier in the season.
Malinin enters the new campaign looking to move on from a dramatic 2025-26 season in which his 14-event winning streak came to an end at the Winter Olympics, where he finished eighth overall in the singles competition.
The disappointment proved short-lived, however, as he rebounded weeks later in Prague to secure a third successive world title.
After Skate America, Malinin is scheduled to compete at the NHK Trophy, where he will bid to secure a place at December's Grand Prix Final, an event he has won in each of the last three seasons.

items.author: Vrinda Tulsian
items.summary: Section 78 of IT Act bars officers below Inspector rank from investigating offences under the law. Centre's high-level committee on digital arrest scams has backed amending the law.

Year after curbs on content takedown powers, Centre weighs allowing junior cops to probe cybercrime

Section 78 of IT Act bars officers below Inspector rank from investigating offences under the law. Centre's high-level committee on digital arrest scams has backed amending the law.

Vrinda Tulsian

14 November, 2026 11:58 am IST

New Delhi: The central government’s high-level committee on digital arrest scams has backed amending the Information Technology Act to let police officers below the rank of Inspector investigate specified cybercrime offences. The minutes, however, do not specify which offences would be covered.

The proposal has been recorded in the minutes of the inter-departmental committee’s 24 September meeting, chaired by the Special Secretary (Internal Security) in the Union Home Ministry. The minutes are annexed to the ministry’s fifth status report to the Supreme Court—seen by ThePrint—filed on 7 October in a suo motu case on digital arrest scams.

Section 78 of the IT Act bars any officer below Inspector rank from investigating offences under the law.

Show Full Article

This proposal comes a year after the IT ministry—in October 2025—amended the IT Rules, so that only police officers of Deputy Inspector General rank or above could issue content takedown notices to platforms.

The 24 September minutes state that the “limited availability of officers of the required rank, particularly Inspectors in specialised cybercrime units, may create an operational bottleneck if the number of FIRs increases substantially”. The committee “considered the need of the suitable amendment”, under which officers “below the present prescribed rank may be empowered to investigate specified cybercrime offences”.

The committee has sought data from I4C, the Union home ministry and the Union IT ministry, so that it can examine “the feasibility of empowering suitably trained officers of lower rank, subject to appropriate safeguards and qualifications”. I4C is an initiative of the Ministry of Home Affairs linked to cybercrime that became an attached office of the ministry in July 2024.

Also Read: Meta tells govt it acted on 61k ‘inciteful posts’ in 2 weeks; claims 95% drop in AI content on platforms

Why the change
The trigger behind the proposal is the e-Zero FIR system, which automatically converts large cybercrime complaints into FIRs. According to the minutes of the panel’s meeting, it has raised the share of complaints registered as FIRs from one-two percent to about eight percent.

The offences covered under IT Act range from hacking and identity theft, to publishing or transmitting “obscene” material online under Section 67, a provision police have also invoked over social media posts. Parliament last changed the rank requirement in 2008, lowering it from Deputy Superintendent of Police to Inspector. Several High Courts have, over time , held that IT Act investigations by officers below Inspector rank do not meet the law’s requirement.

Immigration data & bank checks
The status report details several other measures being undertaken.

The Central Bureau of Investigation’s report, annexed to the filing, says the agency met the Bureau of Immigration “for using the immigration travel database to curb misuse of international roaming connections operated from scam compounds abroad”. It adds that the “technical feasibility of sharing said information was discussed”. CBI presents the talks as a follow-up to its national cyber-crime conference in February this year.

At a 22 July meeting with the Department of Financial Services, and banks’ chief vigilance and technology officers, CBI secured agreement on several steps.

Every bank account is to be linked to the holder’s Aadhaar-verified mobile number. Biometric OTP checks are to be extended to the opening of accounts in all banks. Mule-account databases are to be shared among banks in real time, and the Reserve Bank of India’s AI tool, MuleHunter.AI, is to be strengthened “with IP logs and geolocation data”.

Telecom checks
The Department of Telecommunications told the court in October that on 17 August, it directed telecom operators to block SIM cards issued beyond the legal limit.

Operators are to use a “table of mobile connections and images” made available to them on DoT’s Digital Intelligence Platform, and have until 30 November to comply. I4C also shares with DoT, every day, the mobile numbers reported by complainants on the national cybercrime portal. Operators are to deploy AI and machine-learning tools to “red flag suspect connections, to re-verify them in a time bound manner and to disconnect those which fail verification”.

The home ministry status report submitted in court also records a rise in grievances from account holders, whose bank accounts were frozen, or whose money was held during cybercrime investigations. They went from about 2,000 in May, to 93,041 by 30 September. In a May letter to state police chiefs, I4C said many grievances were being closed “with inadequate or unreasonable remarks”.

Another 983 petitions seeking to unfreeze accounts are pending in high courts. The petitioners include the stock-broking platform Groww, fintech firms such as RapiPay and Resilient Innovations—the company behind BharatPe—and small businesses and individuals.

The Supreme Court will hear the case next on 23 November.

(Edited by Mannat Chugh)

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-エヌビディア前ＣＥＯ、中国人女性との関係巡り幹部に事実と異なる説明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin

[サンフランシスコ １３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin

[サンフランシスコ １３日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、不倫相手とされる中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係について、ティム・テター法務責任者やアリソン・ワゴンフェルド最高マーケティング責任者ら複数の幹部に事実と異なる説明をしていた。事情に詳しい関係者２人と、ロイターが確認した社内のやり取りで明らかになった。

ロイターは、メッセージをそのまま引用しないことを条件に、１０月の複数のやり取りを確認した。このやり取りを報じるのはロイターが初めて。

フアン氏は１２日、エヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任した。近年の人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの中核を担う技術の先駆者として半導体業界の頂点に立った同氏にとって、劇的な転落となった。

同氏は８日の声明で、妻への不貞行為や会社の期待を裏切ったことを謝罪した。声明では、エヌビディアの顧客であるメガスピード・インターナショナルの元幹部、アリス・フアン氏の名前を明示しなかった。米国は同氏について、中国のためにスパイ活動を行っていた可能性を捜査していた。ジェンスン・フアン氏とアリス・フアン氏は同姓だが、親族関係はない。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズは今週初め、ジェンスン・フアン氏がエヌビディアの従業員とも不倫関係にあったと報じた。ロイターは１２日、同氏がさらに別の同社従業員とも親密な関係にあったと報じた。

テター氏はコメント要請に回答しなかった。ワゴンフェルド氏からも直ちに回答は得られなかった。ジェンスン・フアン氏の代理人とエヌビディアの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。アリス・フアン氏の名刺に記載された連絡先に電話と電子メールで問い合わせたが、返答はなかった。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた関係者によると、２０２５年秋と２０２６年１０月、報道機関からの問い合わせをきっかけに、エヌビディアの一部幹部がジェンスン・フアン氏とメガスピードおよびアリス・フアン氏との関係に関心を寄せた。ジェンスン・フアン氏はいずれの際も、交流は適切なものだったと説明した。ロイターが確認したのは２６年１０月のやり取りに限られ、２５年のものは確認していない。

ジェンスン・フアン氏は１０月の２件の別々のメッセージで、テター氏やワゴンフェルド氏らエヌビディア幹部に対し、交流は顧客との通常の商取引に伴うものだったと説明した。他のメッセージでも、メガスピードとの交流は通常の業務の範囲内だったと強調した。

関係者によると、ジェンスン・フアン氏は、ニューヨーク・タイムズが２５年１０月にアリス・フアン氏との公の場での面会に注目した記事を掲載した後、同紙に法的措置を取ることについても協議した。

この記事を受け、ジェンスン・フアン氏は２５年、エヌビディアの一部幹部にアリス・フアン氏との交流について説明したが、不倫関係とは説明しなかったという。最終的に、エヌビディアもジェンスン・フアン氏も同紙を提訴しなかった。同紙の広報担当者は、法的な要求は受けていないと述べた。

アリス・フアン氏との関係がいつ親密になったかは不明だ。インターネット上に投稿され、ロイターが検証した写真には、米国や中国などで２人が一緒にいる様子が写っており、古いものは２０２３年１２月にさかのぼる。

エヌビディアの独立取締役らは今月１０日、米法律事務所ワクテル・リプトン・ローゼン・アンド・カッツに独立調査を委託したと発表した。ニューヨーク・タイムズと米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルが、ジェンスン・フアン氏とアリス・フアン氏の関係や、アリス・フアン氏が中国のためにスパイ活動をしていたという米当局の疑いについて報じたことを受けた措置だ。中国政府は、同氏がスパイだとの見方を否定している。

ロイターは、アリス・フアン氏が中国政府のために活動していたかどうかを独自に確認できていない。

ジェンスン・フアン氏は１０月２９日に公開されたブルームバーグのインタビューで、アリス・フアン氏に関する疑いについて米政府から知らされていなかったと述べた。

エヌビディアの株価は１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から３０％超下落し、時価総額は１兆８０００億ドル超減少した。

この記事を受け、ジェンスン・フアン氏は２５年、エヌビディアの一部幹部にアリス・フアン氏との交流について説明したが、不倫関係とは説明しなかったという。最終的に、エヌビディアもジェンスン・フアン氏も同紙を提訴しなかった。同紙の広報担当者は、法的な要求は受けていないと述べた。

アリス・フアン氏との関係がいつ親密になったかは不明だ。インターネット上に投稿され、ロイターが検証した写真には、米国や中国などで２人が一緒にいる様子が写っており、古いものは２０２３年１２月にさかのぼる。

エヌビディアの独立取締役らは今月１０日、米法律事務所ワクテル・リプトン・ローゼン・アンド・カッツに独立調査を委託したと発表した。ニューヨーク・タイムズと米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルが、ジェンスン・フアン氏とアリス・フアン氏の関係や、アリス・フアン氏が中国のためにスパイ活動をしていたという米当局の疑いについて報じたことを受けた措置だ。中国政府は、同氏がスパイだとの見方を否定している。

ロイターは、アリス・フアン氏が中国政府のために活動していたかどうかを独自に確認できていない。

ジェンスン・フアン氏は１０月２９日に公開されたブルームバーグのインタビューで、アリス・フアン氏に関する疑いについて米政府から知らされていなかったと述べた。

エヌビディアの株価は１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から３０％超下落し、時価総額は１兆８０００億ドル超減少した。

items.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court agreed Friday to hear Robinhood Markets Inc.’s NASDAQ:HOOD appeal seeking to end a shareholder lawsuit alleging the brokerage misled investors about its finances and growth ...
items.body:

/ Benzinga
/ Robinhood Gets Its Day at the Supreme Court Over 2021 IPO Disclosures: Here’s What You Should Know

Robinhood Gets Its Day at the Supreme Court Over 2021 IPO Disclosures: Here’s What You Should Know 1 min read

HOOD GME DOGEUSD
The U.S. Supreme Court agreed Friday to hear Robinhood Markets Inc. ’s HOOD appeal seeking to end a shareholder lawsuit alleging the brokerage misled investors about its finances and growth ahead of its 2021 IPO.
The court is expected to rule by the end of June, according to Reuters.
Securities Act Claims Center on Meme Stock Disclosures
Investors who bought IPO-linked shares sued under the Securities Act of 1933. The law requires companies to disclose accurate information for informed investment decisions.
Plaintiffs allege Robinhood failed to disclose that revenue had shifted toward meme stocks like GameStop Corp. GME and the cryptocurrency Dogecoin DOGEUSD . They say that trading frenzy had faded before the July 2021 IPO. They also cite an "exodus of its traditional customers."
According to the plaintiffs, Robinhood reported declines in revenue and key performance indicators after its IPO. They allege those declines led to a sharp fall in its stock price.
Robinhood has rejected the claims. The company contends its IPO documents made extensive disclosures about future risks and warned of a downturn from the meme-stock and dogecoin-driven trading peaks of early 2021.
Robinhood did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s request for comment.
Lower Courts Split
U.S. District Judge Edward Chen dismissed the case in 2024. The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals revived it in 2025, finding Chen applied the wrong legal standards.
Robinhood argues the ruling exposes companies to massive liability and risks burying investors in trivial information.
Earlier, the Trump administration’s solicitor general, invited by the court to weigh in, recommended that the justices hear the case, but only on when omitting information from an IPO filing can create liability under the Securities Act.
Trading Metrics
Robinhood has a market capitalization of about $70.11 billion. Over the past 52 weeks, its stock has traded as high as $139.75 and as low as $63.52.

Nov 13 : Microsoft said its consumer products services had fully recovered at 4:10 p.m. UTC on Friday (1610 GMT), while it was seeing some sustained recovery for its Microsoft 365 enterprise services.

Nov 14 : Fast bowler Gurnoor Brar has been added to India's squad for the two-test series against New Zealand, while spinner Kuldeep Yadav has been released to play domestic cricket in India, the country's cricket board (BCCI) said on Saturday.
• Brar, 26, will join the test squad in New Zealand and will not be available for Sunday's fifth and final one-day international in Tauranga.
• India will not name a replacement for Brar, with the visitors leading the five-match ODI series 2-1.
• Wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant has linked up with the squad in Wellington after receiving fitness clearance.

SEOUL: South Korea should neither fear China's rise nor underestimate its capabilities, Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said on Saturday (Nov 14), urging deeper cooperation ahead of a regional summit in China next week.
"During this visit to China, I was reminded that we should neither have an unfounded fear of China's rise nor underestimate its capabilities and potential," Cho wrote on X, saying Seoul should build cooperation benefiting both countries by drawing on the autonomy and creativity of its people and companies.
Cho's remarks came after talks and dinner with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing on Friday, their first meeting in about three months.
The ministers discussed bilateral ties, issues on the Korean Peninsula and ways to deliver tangible benefits to people in both countries.

The meeting came ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' summit in Shenzhen on Nov 18-19, which South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will attend. Lee is also scheduled to join a dinner hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Seoul has said.
 

People walk on an overpass decorated with Chinese national flags, ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ meeting, in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, China, Oct 23, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Tingshu Wang)

The summit is expected to bring together several major world leaders. US President Donald Trump is set to meet Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin next Thursday on the sidelines of APEC, with nuclear arms reductions among the issues on the agenda, the White House said.
Cho said Seoul would seek to use Lee's visit to advance bilateral ties and expand "horizontal and mutually beneficial" cooperation in areas where the two countries have complementary strengths.
Lee's administration has sought to improve relations with China, South Korea's largest trading partner, after ties were strained under former president Yoon Suk Yeol, while maintaining Seoul's security alliance with the United States.
Wang said on Friday that China wanted to expand cooperation with South Korea in traditional industries and emerging sectors including artificial intelligence and biomedicine. He said bilateral ties had returned to the right track after exchanges between the two countries' leaders.

US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease: Report

The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades.

The Americas branch of the World Health Organization has reportedly revoked the United States' measles-free status, ending a 26-year run amid continued spread of the disease. (File photo: Reuters/Sebastian Rocandio)

FAST

The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has revoked the United States' measles-elimination status, ending a 26-year run after determining the country failed to halt continuous transmission of the highly contagious virus for more than a year, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (Nov 13).
The international health body did not immediately respond to a request from Reuters for comment on the report, which cited people familiar with the matter.
The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization (WHO) comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades.
Some 7,500 people in the US have been infected with measles and 13 have died since 2025. That period coincides with falling immunisation rates and rising vaccine hesitancy under US Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr., who has for years spread doubts, without scientific evidence, about the safety of measles vaccines.

United States Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr speaks during an event at the Department of Health and Human Services in Washington DC, US, Sep 1, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Evan Vucci)

As part of its evaluation, PAHO reviewed epidemiological and laboratory evidence submitted by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to determine whether the same strain of measles had been circulating in the United States uninterrupted for 12 months or longer, a sign of local transmission rather than imported cases.
Canada, Spain and the UK recently lost measles-elimination status after review by WHO experts. The US dropped out of WHO but remains a member of PAHO, its Americas branch.
Dr Erica Schwartz, director of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, told Reuters in an interview before the decision that if the US lost measles elimination, the agency would be doing "the same exact thing," which entails working with states to encourage immunisation.
As of Thursday, 5,182 confirmed cases of measles had been reported in 2026 to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention from 45 states, New York City and the District of Columbia, surpassing last year's total of 2,289, making it one of the country's worst measles resurgences in decades.
"It is a fully preventable disease. It is unconscionable that we have this amount of measles," said Noel Brewer, a public health professor at the University of North Carolina.
Brewer, who chairs an independent advisory panel on measles, presented the CDC's measles status report along with his group's assessment of that information to PAHO on Tuesday.

A measles alert sign hangs outside the entrance to the Cohen Children's Medical Center in New Hyde Park, New York, US, Mar 14, 2025. (Photo: Reuters/Shannon Stapleton)

That report remains confidential, but a source familiar with the CDC's findings said the agency determined the US had 12 months of continuous transmission of the virus.
The US achieved its measles-elimination status in 2000. A country can halt transmission when 95 per cent of its population is vaccinated, creating so-called herd immunity that also protects those unable to receive the vaccine.
Two doses of the measles vaccine - by far the best way to prevent infection and transmission - provide 97 per cent protection against the virus, which can cause blindness, deafness, brain damage or death.
William Moss, an epidemiology professor at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, said loss of measles elimination was a hit to the United States' reputation as a public health powerhouse. He said it may discourage other countries.
For the average American, he added, it means that the United States will continue to have large outbreaks, putting people at risk of disease, hospitalisation and death.
To restore measles-elimination status, a country must end transmission and remain free of an outbreak for at least 12 months.
The Department of Health and Human Services did not respond to a request for comment.

items.title: 全米空港で約4時間離陸停止、約1万便欠航　サイバー攻撃の証拠今のところないと高官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson　Doyinsola Oladipo　Rajesh Kumar Singh

［ワシントン　１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
David Shepardson　Doyinsola Oladipo　Rajesh Kumar Singh

［ワシントン　１３日　ロイター］ - 全米の空港で１３日、約４時間にわたり離陸が停止した。航空管制センターで通信障害が発生し、連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が、地上待機命令を出した。全米規模の離陸停止としては２００１年９月１１日の米同時多発攻撃以来、最長。航空アナリストらは、航空会社の運航スケジュールが数日にわたって乱れる可能性を指摘した。

マリン国土安全保障長官は、今回の障害がサイバー攻撃や制御不能な人工知能（ＡＩ）システムによるものだという証拠は今のところないと説明した。

ダフィー米運輸長官によると、米国の空域は東部時間午後８時１５分（１４日０１１５ＧＭＴ、日本時間午前１０時１５分）に再開した。ただ、出発便の運航は段階的に再開され、航空各社が通常運航を取り戻すには時間がかかると警告した。

航空便追跡サイトのフライトレーダー２４によると、米東部時間午後１１時３０分までに１万便近くが欠航。うちデルタ航空とアメリカン航空がそれぞれ２２００便超、ユナイテッド航空が１８００便。主要空港では、駐機場の空きを５時間以上待った機体もあったという。 

ダフィー氏によると、問題は午後３時３６分に始まり、航空管制センターでレーダーと通信システムが不安定になった。「スイッチやルーターがデータで過負荷状態になり、ルーターからのデータに不整合が生じ始めた。そのためシステムを停止した」と説明した。ただ、レーダーや通信の機能が完全に失われたことはなく、数千機を安全に着陸させることができたという。

航空会社の関係者２人によると、障害は防衛・通信機器大手Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズが管理する通信網に影響を及ぼしているもようだ。この通信網は、管制官がパイロットとの交信に使う重要な無線周波数を扱っている。 Ｌ３ハリスはコメントの要請に応じなかった。

米国の航空管制システムは、技術の老朽化や設備・通信の問題、数千人規模の管制官不足が問題となっている。今回の障害は、そうした課題を改めて示した。

ダフィー氏は、目先の問題は解消され、飛行の安全は確保されているとした一方、同様の障害を防ぐには老朽化した航空管制システムの抜本的な刷新が必要だと指摘。新システムへの資金を拠出していないとして議会を批判し、近代化に向けて５００億ドルの予算を求めた。

ホワイトハウスと運輸省は１３日の障害発生前、国内の老朽化した空港と航空管制インフラの更新に向け、３０１億ドルの予算を承認するよう議会に要請していた。

マリン氏は、今回の障害がサイバー攻撃やＡＩ暴走によるものだという証拠は今のところ「全くない」と述べた。「機器的な要因によるものとみられる。ただ、調査は続けている」と述べ、国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）が国土安全保障省と連携して調査に当たっているとした。

アメリカン航空は、早期の回復に向けて機体と乗員を配置するため、国際線と主要拠点空港以外の地方都市への便を優先して運航していると述べた。

US flight shutdown exposes deepening air traffic network crisis

The nationwide flight shutdown on Friday (Nov 13) has exposed longstanding weaknesses in the US air traffic control network, raising questions about whether billions of dollars in modernisation efforts can prevent further disruptions.

The Air Traffic Control tower at Chicago O'Hare International Airport, after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop, in Chicago, Illinois, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Jim Vondruska)

FAST

CHICAGO: A communications failure that halted flight departures across the United States on Friday (Nov 13) has renewed scrutiny of the country's ageing air traffic control network, raising questions about its resilience even as the government spends billions of dollars to modernise it.
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop , preventing aircraft from departing US airports, following "a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers", Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a post on X.
Duffy later attributed the outage to a problem with the FAA's legacy network, saying switches and routers had become overloaded with data and went down. It was not immediately clear what caused the equipment overload.
The FAA lifted the ground stop after more than four hours, but Duffy warned that it would take time for air traffic operations to return to full capacity.

More than 1.5 million passengers were scheduled to depart US airports on roughly 11,000 flights after 4pm Eastern Time (2100 GMT), shortly after the ground stop began, according to aviation analytics firm Cirium.

Travellers wait in line at ticket counters at LaGuardia Airport in New York after the US Federal Aviation Administration grounded flights nationwide, on Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: AP/Ryan Murphy)

The shutdown came on the same day the White House and Transportation Department sought another US$30.1 billion from Congress to upgrade airports and air traffic control, including US$10.1 billion for air traffic control modernisation.
Much of the system's underlying weakness has been documented for years.
The Government Accountability Office reported in 2024 that the FAA had classified 51 of its 138 air traffic control systems as unsustainable and another 54 as potentially unsustainable. Together, they accounted for more than three-quarters of the systems reviewed.
FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford told Reuters in September that the agency's more than 300 air traffic facilities operated as technological silos, relying in some cases on decades-old computers and telecommunications systems that cannot communicate seamlessly with one another.
Some obsolete equipment requires replacement parts obtained through online auction websites or made using 3D printing.
BACKUP SYSTEMS UNDER STRAIN An incident in September demonstrated how one communications failure could be compounded by another.
After error messages appeared on a telecommunications circuit serving a Philadelphia air traffic control facility, the FAA's contractor switched to a backup fibre-optic line. A construction crew then accidentally severed that line in New Jersey, contributing to widespread disruption. About 9,500 US flights were delayed or cancelled that day.
"When it fails, we just don't have the redundancy that we would get if we had a modern architecture," Bedford said at the time.
Friday's shutdown was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023, when a failure of the FAA system that distributes critical safety notices to pilots halted departures for less than two hours and disrupted more than 10,000 flights.

A person takes a photo of a screen displaying information on delayed and cancelled flights after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop, at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport in Atlanta, Georgia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Elijah Nouvelage)

Congress approved US$12.5 billion in July 2025 to modernise the country's ageing air traffic control infrastructure, including telecommunications and radar systems. The administration said Friday that 68 per cent of the FAA's legacy copper telecommunications network had been replaced with high-speed fibre.
But Bedford warned in September that replacing ageing copper wires with fibre-optic cables alone would not prevent future outages without a modern telecommunications network.
The overhaul faces challenges beyond securing money.
In September, the Government Accountability Office warned that the FAA lacked a reliable cost estimate and an integrated master schedule for its air traffic control modernisation programme.
Instead, as of May, it had 11,389 separate project schedules that were not coordinated, raising the risk of repeated work at the same facilities, delays and cost overruns.
The FAA aims to complete the first phase of modernisation by December 2028. But the GAO warned that inadequate planning increased the risk of delays, potentially leaving the agency dependent on outdated systems prone to failure for longer.

items.title: 米中会談、トランプ氏はスパイ疑惑提起しない見通し＝米当局者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jasper Ward

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jasper Ward

[ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 米当局者は１３日、トランプ米大統領が中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、中国のスパイと疑われる女性実業家アリス・フアン氏を巡る問題を取り上げる見通しはないと明らかにした。同氏は、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫関係にあったとされる。

トランプ氏は４日間のアジア歴訪の一環として、来週に中国の深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて習氏と会談する予定。フアン氏は１２日にエヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任しており、会談はそのわずか数日後に行われることになる。

半導体は米中関係の主要な対立点となってきたが、当局者によると、トランプ氏は今回の問題を当面、習氏に提起しない見通しだ。

米政権高官の１人は記者団に対し「こうした国家安全保障上の問題や、米国内で進められている調査・捜査の一部について、現時点で中国側に詳しく知らせることは、おそらくないだろう」と述べた。

別の米当局者も「大統領がアリス・フアン氏の問題を取り上げるとは思わない」と語った。

中国政府は、アリス氏がスパイだとの疑惑を否定している。アリス氏には連絡が取れなかった。ロイターは、アリス氏が中国政府のために活動していたかどうかを独自に確認できていない。米司法省は、アリス氏と中国政府との関係について、いかなる結論にも達していないとしている。

By Brad Brooks and Steve Gorman
Nov 13 (Reuters) – A tanker ship collided with a luxury paddle wheeler docked in New Orleans on the Mississippi River on Friday, causing the cruise vessel to roll over and sink as passengers scurried to disembark and dozens were flung into the water.

All aboard the stricken ship were accounted for after harbor personnel, firefighters and onlookers scrambled to pull fallen passengers to safety, New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno told a press conference.

Hailing the outcome as “a miracle on the Mississippi,” she said 32 passengers from American Cruise Lines paddle wheeler American Heritage were hospitalized, but “none with any type of critical injuries.”

Show Full Article

Moreno said roughly 180 to 190 passengers and crew members were aboard the American Heritage at the time of the mishap. The cruise ship has a capacity for 150 passengers and was built in 2015, American Cruise Lines said on its website.

The accident occurred about midday when the tanker ship, the Atlantic Asphalt, “lost control and collided” with the docked cruise vessel, Moreno said.

As passengers began fleeing, the cruise ship started to sink and eventually “toppled over and flipped,” dumping people into the river, the mayor said.

Harbor Police Chief Melanie Montroll said about 87 passengers from the American Heritage disembarked before the vessel capsized, according to the joint news site of the New Orleans Advocate and Times-Picayune.

Moreno credited a swift response by local, state and federal personnel and bystanders from other vessels for preventing any loss of life.

The US Coast Guard said in an emailed statement that all river traffic was closed in the vicinity of the accident following the collision.

Coast Guard Captain Melanie Burnham told the New Orleans Advocate that the tanker appeared to have experienced some sort of steering failure but the cause of the mishap remained under investigation.

American Cruise Lines said in an emailed statement that it was coordinating with the Coast Guard and local authorities.

“Guests and crew were evacuated, and we are deeply concerned for everyone involved,” the company said.

(Reporting by Brad Brooks and Steve Gorman; Additional reporting by Ismail Shakil, Christian Martinez and Ryan Jones; Editing by Edmund Klamann and William Mallard)

By David Shepardson, Doyinsola Oladipo and Rajesh Kumar Singh
WASHINGTON, Nov 13 (Reuters) – The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday after a communications failure at air traffic control centers caused chaos at airports and triggered the longest nationwide shutdown since the September 11, 2001, attacks.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said US airspace reopened at 8:15 p.m. Eastern Time (0115 GMT), but warned that departures would resume gradually and it would take time for airlines to restore normal operations.

“It’s going to be slow,” Duffy told reporters at the White House.

Show Full Article

More than 6,600 flights were canceled and 8,600 delayed, with another 1,500 already canceled for Sunday, according to FlightRadar24. Aviation analysts said the four-hour nationwide grounding could disrupt airline schedules for days.

Duffy said tens of thousands of passengers were stranded at airports around the country.

The failure is the latest and most dramatic sign of strain on a US air traffic control system beset by aging technology, equipment and communications problems and a shortage of several thousand controllers.

Duffy said the trouble began at 3:36 p.m., when air traffic control centers experienced instability in radar and communications systems. Switches and routers carrying critical data became overloaded, producing inconsistent information and prompting the FAA to halt departures nationwide, he said.  

“Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they started to give us inconsistencies in the data from those routers and because of that we shut the system down,” Duffy said, adding at no stage did they completely lose radar or communications and were able to safely land thousands of planes.

Duffy said the immediate problem had been fixed and that flying was safe, but warned that a broader overhaul of the aging air traffic control system was needed to prevent similar failures.

$50 BILLION AVIATION OVERHAUL

Duffy blamed Congress for failing to fund a new system that he said could prevent such outages, and called for $50 billion to modernize it.

Earlier on Friday, before the outage, the White House and Department of Transportation had urged Congress to approve $30.1 billion to upgrade the nation’s aging airports and air traffic control infrastructure.

“What we have is an incredibly old air traffic control system,” Duffy said.

“Give us the money to fix it.”

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was “zero evidence” so far that the outage resulted from a cyberattack or a rogue AI system, though investigators had not ruled out either possibility.

“It appears this was mechanically driven, however, we’re still looking,” Mullin said.

The National Security Agency was working with the Department of Homeland Security on the investigation, he added.

The only other nationwide ground stop since the September 11 attacks came in January 2023, when the FAA halted domestic departures for about 90 minutes.

Investors were already pricing in a financial hit to airlines. Shares of American Airlines, United Airlines and Delta Air Lines fell between 1% and 2% in after-hours trading, while JetBlue Airways dropped about 3%.

items.title: Dueños de 721.000 autos BMW en EE.UU. deben estacionar afuera por riesgo de incendio
items.author: Amy Stillman
items.summary: Estos vehículos ya habían sido objeto de una campaña de retirada en 2024 debido a un problema con la bomba de agua y deben ser reparados de nuevo.
items.body: Bloomberg — Los conductores de casi 721.000 vehículos de BMW AG deben aparcar en el exterior debido a un defecto que podría provocar un incendio, según informó el viernes la Administración Nacional de Seguridad del Tráfico en las Carreteras de Estados Unidos (NHTSA). La semana pasada, BMW retiró del mercado 14 modelos de los años 2012 a 2018 debido a un conector eléctrico mal sellado en la bomba de agua que puede quedar expuesto al agua y provocar un cortocircuito, aumentando el riesgo de incendio cuando el vehículo está estacionado y apagado. Ver más: BMW acelera el lanzamiento de nuevos modelos tras rebajar nuevamente sus previsiones de rentabilidad Estos vehículos ya habían sido objeto de una campaña de retirada en 2024 debido a un problema con la bomba de agua y deben ser reparados de nuevo. BMW identificó 10 incidentes que podrían estar relacionados con este problema en vehículos que habían sido reparados en el marco de la campaña anterior, según informó la NHTSA. No se han registrado accidentes ni heridos. “Si usted posee uno de estos vehículos, debe estacionarlo al aire libre, lejos de edificios y otros vehículos, hasta que el vehículo sea reparado”, indicó la agencia en una alerta para el consumidor el viernes. La compañía aún no dispone de una solución, aunque está trabajando en una. Se prevé que las notificaciones comiencen a enviarse a partir del 25 de diciembre, según informó la NHTSA. BMW no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Ver más: BMW supera expectativas tras recortes de costos, pero enfrenta presión en China BMW busca reducir costos y reestructurar su equipo directivo para hacer frente a la creciente competencia de los fabricantes de automóviles chinos. La semana pasada, el fabricante alemán revisó a la baja sus previsiones de beneficios y presentó planes para aumentar la producción de sus modelos de próxima generación con el fin de reforzar la rentabilidad en los próximos años. items.title: サッカー＝メッシ引退のアルゼンチン、ウルグアイに敗戦　国際親善試合
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が１３日に各地で行われ、アルゼンチンはホームでウルグアイに１─２で敗れた。

リオネル・メッシの代表引退後初の試合を迎えたアルゼンチンだが、後半３分にオウンゴールで先制を許すと、同８分にも失点。後半２８分にはジャンルカ・プレスティアンニのアシストからフリアン・アルバレスのゴールで１点を返すも、そのまま敗れた。

アルゼンチンはこの後、１７日の国際親善試合でコスタリカをホームに迎える。

サウジアラビアはカタールの首都ドーハで韓国と対戦し、３─２で勝利。オーストラリアはアウェーでカタールに３─０で快勝した。

items.title: テニス＝スビトリナがサバレンカ破り4強、ＷＴＡファイナル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］　 - 女子テニスのシーズン最終戦、ＷＴＡファイナルは１３日、米カリフォルニア州インディアンウェルズでシングルスの１次リーグ最終戦を行い、２組では第６シードのエリナ・スビトリナ（ウクライナ）が第２シードでベラルーシ出身のアリーナ・サバレンカを破り、準決勝進出を決めた。

スビトリナは第１セットの第１ゲームでブレークを許したものの、ブレークバックに成功。さらに相手のサービスゲームを破って逆転し、６─３で先取した。第２セットはサバレンカがサービスブレークで主導権を握り、６─３で取り返して勝負を最終セットに持ち込んだ。

スビトリナは最終セットでサバレンカのサービスゲームを３度ブレークし、６─１で１時間５３分の熱戦を制した。サバレンカ戦では２０２０年以来６年ぶりの白星で、連敗を５で止めた。

スビトリナは１次リーグを２勝１敗の同組２位で通過し、２０１９年以来の準決勝進出。一方、サバレンカは１勝２敗で敗退となった。

すでに同組１位での４強入りを決めていた第３シードでロシア出身のミラ・アンドレエワは、同じくロシア出身のディアナ・シュナイデルに６─２、６─１で快勝。５５分でストレート勝ちを収め、１次リーグを３連勝で終えた。シュナイデルは体調不良のため欠場したカロリナ・ムホバ（チェコ）に代わって出場した。

準決勝ではスビトリナがリンダ・ノスコバ（チェコ）、アンドレエワがジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）と対戦する。

items.title: EE.UU. levanta suspensión de vuelos tras más de cuatro horas de paralización por una falla técnica
items.author: Will Guisbond, Sri Taylor, Courtney Subramanian
items.summary: La suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional, la tercera en la historia de Estados Unidos, se produjo mientras la FAA lidia con la obsolescencia de su infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo y la crec ...
items.body: Bloomberg — La Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA) canceló la suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional tras una interrupción en las telecomunicaciones que paralizó las salidas de vuelos en todo Estados Unidos, según un aviso en su sitio web, lo que permitió a las aerolíneas reanudar sus operaciones después de más de cuatro horas. La suspensión de operaciones en tierra se levantó a las 20:15 del viernes por la noche, luego de que la falla en las comunicaciones afectara a los centros de control de tráfico aéreo en todo el país. Las aerolíneas ahora se enfrentan al reto de restablecer sus horarios tras la interrupción, con retrasos y cancelaciones que podrían extenderse por todo el sistema de aviación durante horas mientras las compañías aéreas trabajan para que los aviones y las tripulaciones vuelvan a sus puestos. Ver más: FBI investiga si una actualización de software causó la falla que afectó al tráfico aéreo en EE.UU. “Nuestros conmutadores y enrutadores se sobrecargaron de datos y dejaron de funcionar”, declaró el secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy, en una rueda de prensa. “En realidad, no debería decir que dejaron de funcionar. Empezaron a presentar inconsistencias en los datos que recibían de esos enrutadores. Por eso, tuvimos que desconectar el sistema”. La inusual suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional, la tercera en la historia de Estados Unidos, se produjo mientras la FAA lidia con la obsolescencia de su infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo y la creciente presión para modernizar sus sistemas. La agencia había ordenado inicialmente que todos los vuelos con salida permanecieran en tierra hasta nuevo aviso, alegando circunstancias extraordinarias y preocupaciones de seguridad. “Nos llevará algún tiempo deshacer lo sucedido esta tarde”, añadió Duffy. Duffy declaró el viernes que el problema de comunicaciones afectó a todos los centros de control de tráfico aéreo, que gestionan las aeronaves que vuelan a gran altitud. La FAA atribuyó la interrupción a un fallo temporal en las telecomunicaciones, aunque la causa exacta sigue bajo investigación. “Teníamos más de 3.500 aviones en el aire”, dijo Duffy en una conferencia de prensa. “Todos participaron en la maniobra, y la última vez que revisé, teníamos menos de 400 en el espacio aéreo, ya que todos se dirigían a aterrizar de forma segura, y lo gestionamos con nuestros procedimientos habituales para este tipo de incidentes”. Según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, el FBI no cree que la interrupción del servicio haya sido causada por un ciberataque o actividad delictiva. Los investigadores están analizando si una actualización de software pudo haber provocado la interrupción, añadió la misma fuente. Ver más: Qué pasó con los aeropuertos y vuelos en Estados Unidos hoy, 13 de noviembre Este cierre supuso la tercera interrupción a nivel nacional de las operaciones en tierra en la historia de Estados Unidos, tras la interrupción en 2023 del sistema de notificación de seguridad de la FAA para pilotos y despachadores y los atentados terroristas del 11 de septiembre de 2001. Esta interrupción se produce mientras la FAA emprende una modernización integral de su anticuada infraestructura de control de tráfico aéreo, respaldada por US$12.500 millones de financiación del Congreso. Duffy ha solicitado US$30.000 millones adicionales para este proyecto, y el Departamento de Transporte renovó dicha solicitud esta semana. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: トランプ氏、19日に中ロ首脳と核削減協議へ　米政府発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン １３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン １３日　ロイター] - ホワイトハウスは１３日、トランプ米大統領が来週１９日に中国でロシアのプーチン大統領、中国の習近平国家主席と会談し、核兵器の削減について協議すると明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスのオリビア・ウェールズ報道官は記者団との電話会見で「世界の核兵器削減について協議する。トランプ大統領は核兵器の拡散を非常に危険だと考えている」と述べた。

トランプ氏は、初めてとなる３カ国首脳会談で核兵器削減を主要議題にするよう繰り返し主張している。一方、貿易・商業に焦点を当てた首脳会議を主催する中国は、これに反発している。中国は、世界最大規模の核兵器を保有するロシアと米国との核協議を拒んできた。 

プーチン氏、習氏、トランプ氏は、中国・深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて会談する見通し。トランプ氏は１６日、フィリピン訪問も含む４日間のアジア歴訪に出発する。

ただ、トランプ政権高官は核問題について「何らかの合意に至るとは見込んでいない」とした上で、「今後、生産的なものとなることを期待する対話の始まりだ」と述べた。

ロシアと中国がトランプ氏との核兵器削減協議に応じる意向があるかどうかは明らかになっていない。

在米中国大使館とロシア大使館は、電子メールによるコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

先の高官によると、トランプ氏は会談で米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争も取り上げるが、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を議題にする予定はない。

トランプ氏は、プーチン氏との個別会談や、イーロン・マスク氏のスペースＸが提供する衛星通信サービスのウクライナによる利用を巡る協議も予定していない。マスク氏はトランプ氏の訪中に同行するが、習氏、プーチン氏との会談には出席しないという。

また、トランプ氏は今回のアジア歴訪中、北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記とも会談する予定はないという。

items.title: US lifts nationwide ground stop, allowing flights to resume after hours of travel chaos
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The rare nationwide ground stop order, issued due to a communications problem affecting US air traffic control towers, caused chaos at airports and triggered the longest shutdown since the 9/11 attacks in 2001.
items.body:

World

US lifts nationwide ground stop, allowing flights to resume after hours of travel chaos

The rare nationwide ground stop order, issued due to a communications problem affecting US air traffic control towers, caused chaos at airports and triggered the longest shutdown since the 9/11 attacks in 2001.

A plane lands after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop "due to extraordinary circumstances and reasons for safety" following the agency's earlier report of serious air traffic control communications issues at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Virginia, US, November 13, 2026. REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst

(Updated: 14 Nov 2026 12:23PM)

WASHINGTON: The United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday (Nov 13) after a communications failure at air traffic control centres caused chaos at airports and triggered the longest nationwide shutdown since the Sep 11, 2001, attacks.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said US airspace reopened at 8.15pm Eastern Time (0115 GMT), but warned that departures would resume gradually and it would take time for airlines to restore normal operations.
"It's going to be slow," Duffy told reporters at the White House.
More than 6,600 flights were cancelled and 8,600 delayed, with another 1,500 already cancelled for Sunday, according to FlightRadar24. Aviation analysts said the four-hour nationwide grounding could disrupt airline schedules for days.

Duffy said tens of thousands of passengers were stranded at airports around the country.
The failure is the latest and most dramatic sign of strain on a US air traffic control system beset by ageing technology, equipment and communications problems and a shortage of several thousand controllers.

Traffic outside the terminal after the US Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop "due to extraordinary circumstances and reasons for safety" following the agency's earlier report of serious air traffic control communications issues at Dulles International Airport, in Dulles, Virginia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Daniel Heuer

Duane Hanson's "The Traveler" statue rests as people wait in Terminal B during a nationwide ground stop at Orlando International Airport in Orlando City, on Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Getty Images via AFP/Finn Gomez)

Duffy said the trouble began at 3.36 pm when air traffic control centres experienced instability in radar and communications systems. Switches and routers carrying critical data became overloaded, producing inconsistent information and prompting the FAA to halt departures nationwide, he said.
"Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they started to give us inconsistencies in the data from those routers and because of that we shut the system down," Duffy said, adding at no stage did they completely lose radar or communications and were able to safely land thousands of planes.
Duffy said the immediate problem had been fixed and that flying was safe, but warned that a broader overhaul of the ageing air traffic control system was needed to prevent similar failures.

United States Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy takes questions as US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin looks on in the James S Brady Press Briefing Room at the White House in Washington DC, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Elizabeth Frantz)

US$50 BILLION AVIATION OVERHAUL Duffy blamed Congress for failing to fund a new system that he said could prevent such outages, and called for US$50 billion to modernise it.
Earlier on Friday, before the outage, the White House and Department of Transportation had urged Congress to approve US$30.1 billion to upgrade the nation's ageing airports and air traffic control infrastructure.
"What we have is an incredibly old air traffic control system," Duffy said.
"Give us the money to fix it."

A person waits during delays and cancellations at LaGuardia airport on Nov 13, 2026, in the Queens borough of New York City. (Photo: Getty Images via AFP/Adam Gray)

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was "zero evidence" so far that the outage resulted from a cyberattack or a rogue AI system, although investigators had not ruled out either possibility.
"It appears this was mechanically driven, however, we're still looking," Mullin said.
The National Security Agency was working with the Department of Homeland Security on the investigation, he added.
The outage appeared to be affecting a telecommunications network overseen by L3Harris Technologies, according to two airline officials. The network handles critical radio frequencies used by air traffic controllers to communicate with pilots. L3Harris did not respond to a request for comment.
PAIN NOT OVER FOR PASSENGERS Though the ground stop was lifted, the disruption for passengers was far from over. From Boston to Seattle and New York to Los Angeles, passengers crowded departure halls and airline desks as delays and cancellations mounted and aircraft remained parked at gates.

People wait inside a terminal at Dulles International Airport after the US Federal Aviation Administration issues a national ground stop, in Dulles, Virginia, US, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Daniel Heuer)

Thousands of passengers faced being stranded overnight. Edward Kargbo, 50, from West Chester, Pennsylvania, had been scheduled to take a 9pm Ethiopian Airlines flight to Lome, Togo.
Instead, he planned to spend the night at the airport before a rescheduled flight at 6am on Saturday.
“I have to squat the night here,” he said. “I’m stranded.”
Louise Maher, 47, was also caught up in the disruption at Newark after her British Airways flight to London was caught up in the aviation meltdown.
“I might cry at some point but not yet,” she said.
US airlines will not be required to provide compensation to stranded passengers because the carriers were not responsible for the FAA system failures.
The only other nationwide ground stop since the Sep 11 attacks came in January 2023, when the FAA halted domestic departures for about 90 minutes.
Investors were already pricing in a financial hit to airlines. Shares of American Airlines, United Airlines and Delta Air Lines fell between 1 per cent and 2 per cent in after-hours trading, while JetBlue Airways dropped about 3 per cent.
American Airlines said it was prioritising flights to smaller cities outside its major hubs and international destinations to position aircraft and crews for a faster recovery.

items.title: Tata Sons listing will change 'Tata way', will engage with regulators: Noel
items.summary: Noel said while 'some people' are proposing a listing for group's holding company, he fears that enlarging the number of shareholders after a listing will shift its focus to profits from philanthropy ...
items.body:
Home / Companies / News / Tata Sons listing will change 'Tata way', will engage with regulators: Noel

Tata Sons listing will change 'Tata way', will engage with regulators: Noel Noel said while 'some people' are proposing a listing for group's holding company, he fears that enlarging the number of shareholders after a listing will shift its focus to profits from philanthropy

The comments come at a time when ruptures at the top echelons of the country's largest conglomerate are out in the open | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 14 2026 | 2:55 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata on Saturday said that listing Tata Sons will "fundamentally change" the over 150-year-old group's way of working and stressed that its largest owner will play a "constructive role" in engaging with the regulators to retain the conglomerate's unlisted character.
Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit here, Noel said while "some people" are proposing a listing for the group's holding company, he fears that enlarging the number of shareholders after a listing will shift its focus to profits from philanthropy.
"My worry is that listing, which is what some people are proposing, will change the Tata way. And one day, if we have 30,000-40,000 shareholders, profit may take precedence over philanthropy. And I think that will fundamentally change the Tata way of working," Noel, who turned 70 on Friday, was quoted as saying.
 

"Tata Trusts will play a constructive role with regulators and others to try and find a solution which keeps the Tata way the way it is," he added.
The 'Tata way' represents continuity, the half-brother of Ratan Tata who took over the reins of Tata Trusts after the death of the group's more charismatic leader, said, adding that an owner cannot die, retire or be bought in the model.

Who is Sunil D'Souza, the new Voltas Chairman succeeding Noel Tata?

The comments come at a time when ruptures at the top echelons of the country's largest conglomerate are out in the open, with Noel-led Tata Trusts, which owns two-thirds stake in the holding company Tata Sons, opposed to a listing, while the management of Tata Sons led by chairman N Chandrasekaran says it will have to follow the law of the land and list as per the RBI's instructions.

It can be recalled that Noel also dissented against Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman at a board meet on September 17 this year.
Noel, who is reported to have expressed concerns over capital allocation and returns made in bets like Air India, digital and semiconductors businesses under Chandrasekaran, also said that he is "pleased" with the firsts that the group has achieved and included the semi-conductor project, battery and electric vehicle battery that it is putting up in the list.
Speaking at the HTLS, Noel said that there has not been any change in the strategic direction of the group in terms of governance and added that discipline is needed to execute very large projects.

"Philanthropy on one hand. Nation building on other. This is independence of leadership and personalities and this will continue. I do not question the direction of what we have done. I question, sometimes, the delivery of what we are doing," Noel said.
He said the Westside business was the country's first direct to consumer business by opting for private labels, where it owns the entire chain right from the fabric to the store in which the finished product is sold.
Consumption has skyrocketed in the country over the past decade, he said, adding that Westside now boasts of 320 stores and is looking to see when it can touch 500.

"'While we the team (at Westside) has done a fantastic job in addressing the opportunity, I think full credit has to go to the economy, to India, the way consumption is growing is incredible," he said.
He also recalled starting of Trent, and claimed that Tatas were the "pioneers of retail" in the country.
The brand 'Zudio' was launched to cater to the bottom of the pyramid, he said, stressing that the price points of products remain the same even a decade later.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のレッドソックスが、今季ワールドシリーズを制したブルワーズのジェーク・バウアーズ内野手（３１）と４年総額５８００万ドル（約９２億６０００万円）の契約で合意したと、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１３日に報じた。

バウアーズはブルワーズでの３年目となった今季、レギュラーシーズン１４４試合に出場し、打率２割６分６厘、２６本塁打、８６打点といずれも自己最高の成績を記録。ドジャースを４連勝で下したナ・リーグ優勝決定シリーズでは最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれた。

ブルワーズはシーズン終了後、バウアーズに１年２３１５万ドルのクオリファイング・オファー（ＱＯ）を提示していた。

バウアーズは２０１８年のメジャーデビュー以降、レイズ、インディアンス（現ガーディアンズ）、マリナーズ、ヤンキース、ブルワーズでプレー。通算７５７試合で打率２割２分３厘、８４本塁打、２９７打点、５０盗塁を記録している。

items.title: サッカー＝ベッカム氏米国サッカー殿堂入り、ラピノー氏とアーツ氏も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１３日　ロイター］ - 米国サッカー殿堂は１２日、元イングランド代表主将のデービッド・ベッカム氏（５１）、元米国女子代表のミーガン・ラピノー氏（４１）、ジュリー・アーツ氏（３４）らが２０２７年の殿堂入りメンバーに選出されたと発表した。

ベッカム氏は０７年に米メジャーリーグサッカー（ＭＬＳ）のロサンゼルス・ギャラクシーに加入し、１１年と１２年のリーグ制覇に貢献。現在は元アルゼンチン代表リオネル・メッシが所属するインテル・マイアミの共同オーナーを務める。

ラピノー氏とアーツ氏はともに、米国が１５年と１９年の女子ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）を制した際の主力選手で、資格取得１年目での選出となった。

ラピノー氏は０６年から２３年まで米国代表として２０３試合に出場し、６３得点を記録。１９年の女子Ｗ杯では得点王と最優秀選手に輝き、同年の女子バロンドール（フランス・フットボール誌選定の権威ある年間最優秀選手賞）も受賞した。アーツ氏は代表１２３試合で２０得点を挙げた。

このほか、元米国代表ＦＷジョジー・アルティドール氏（３７）、元同代表監督ローター・オジアンダー氏（８７）、室内サッカーで８００得点以上を挙げたタトゥ氏（６４）も選ばれた。殿堂入り式典は来年４月１６日にテキサス州フリスコで開催される。
